description: Translator suggestion box, sprint 1118 (26 languages, on feat/library-order).

entries.complaint: The bold label 'Values' maps to lpn_settings_defaults (new-asset values, rendered 'قيم الإنشاء'), but in the Find definitions 'Values' means the values typed into a query, so the label key does not name that thing.
readings: bold plain 'القيم' (the typed values)
bold the label string 'قيم الإنشاء' (creation values)

entries.complaint: Values is bolded as if it were the Settings label Values, but the sentence means the numbers being compared; same for the Values row in lpn_guide_find_query_def.
readings: plain word for the numbers compared, bolded as English shows
the Settings, Assets, Values label (bn: শুরুর মান)

entries.complaint: Color nodes by and Node colors share one bn label (নোডের রঙ), so the sentence naming both reads as a repetition.
readings: same label for both, as the label keys have it
a distinct label for Color nodes by

entries.complaint: The manual bolds Values as if it were the Settings label, but in this sentence it is an ordinary noun; the house Hebrew label for Settings Values (ערכי יצירה) does not read as that noun.
readings: bolded the ordinary Hebrew word ערכים
bolded the label string ערכי יצירה

entries.complaint: Same: the table row Values is bolded as a label, yet it explains how to type values.
readings: bolded ערכים
bolded ערכי יצירה

entries.complaint: The bold-label spec ties the Find box's bold 'Values' (this key and lpn_guide_find_query_def) to lpn_settings_defaults, whose Burmese label means 'creation-time values' and is wrong for Find.
readings: bolded the plain word for values
bolded the settings_defaults label

entries.complaint: The old Pashto text said extended period simulation always runs on EPANET, which the new English contradicts; I retranslated it fully, so it was not a bold-only change.
readings: retranslated from the current English
kept old words and only added bold

entries.complaint: The existing Pashto for ct_box, ct_example and ct_what did not match the current English (missing sentences, garbled), so I retranslated them whole; they were not bold-only.
readings: retranslated from current English
kept old words

entries.complaint: The bold spec ties 'Closed' to lpn_pane_shape_closed (a Shape property, ru 'Замкнута'), but the text means a pipe's Closed status, which is lpn_field_closed (ru 'Закрыта').
readings: bolded Закрыта (the pipe status on screen)
bolded Замкнута per the spec key

entries.complaint: 'Values' is bound to lpn_settings_defaults (ru 'Значения при создании'), but in the Find table it is a plain heading about typing values, not that Settings label.
readings: bolded the heading Значения
bolded the Settings label verbatim

entries.complaint: The bold word Values in the Find notes and query tables is mapped in the bold list to the label of 'Values' under New assets (lpn_settings_defaults), but the sentence is about the Find box Value field.
readings: the Find value field (lpn_find_value, 数值)
the Settings New assets Values label (创建值)
